displayTitle: Agent of the Empire: Hard Targets #3
synopsis: A young boy, the heir to the title of Count Dooku, is kidnapped, and it's Jahan Cross to the rescue! When the kidnapper turns out to be a sexy female spy with whom Cross has worked before, and when her motives turn out to have the boy's welfare at heart, Cross is faced with a decision: should he disobey his own orders from the Empire? But first there's a little matter of breaking out of a supposedly inescapable prison...
title: Agent of the Empire: Hard Targets #3
